incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=redwood-inference-queue, symptom=queue_length > 10k, severity=high :rotating_light:
pagerduty: INC12345 triggered — urgent for eng-oncall. Auto-escalation in 5m if not acknowledged. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC12345
Alex W: acked. I'm on it — looking at hotcell metrics now.
Priya S: thanks — can you confirm customer impact? any 5xx or increased latency?
Alex W: seeing 503 spikes on the frontend monitoring, ~0.8% of requests in past 2m. dashboard: https://dashboards/redwood/queues?cell=hotcell
Marco R: autoscaler logs show repeated scale failures: "scale_attempt_failed: quota_exceeded" across nodepool-spot-2.
Alex W: copying logs: ```kubectl -n inference get hpa hotcell -o yaml``` HPA metrics at 95% target, replicas stuck at 12.
Jamie (support): CS reported a customer with degraded embeddings job — ticket #TKT-4492. They see long waits.
Ops Liaison: quick note — spot pool quota is limited until 22:00 UTC due to provider maintenance. Fallback to reserved pool possible but slower spin-up.
Priya S: plan: (1) try manual scale to reserved pool, (2) route new requests to fallback model variant, (3) notify PD if manual scale fails.
Alex W: running manual scale script now: `/ops/scale-reserved --pool reserved-gpu --count 8 --reason "hotcell overflow"`
incident-bot: action logged by Alex W — manual scale requested.
Marco R: checking autoscaler controller logs: `error: insufficient quota` and `fallback_attempt=0`. There is a bug where fallback policy isn't triggering when spot quota exhausted. Pushing a quick config patch to enable fallback_attempts=2.
Alex W: manual scale returned success on API but nodes not provisioning yet. kube events show `ProvisioningCapacityExceeded`.
Priya S: mitigation step 2: enable traffic routing rule to redirect 20% new traffic to smaller-quantized model (r: q4) to relieve hotpath. Jamie, can you post customer comms template?
Jamie (support): posted draft in #support-drafts, tagging product. Short note: "We're aware of increased latency for some requests; engineering is actively mitigating. Updates every 15m"
pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by Alex W at 1835000035. Escalation timer paused.
Marco R: config patch applied to autoscaler: `enable_fallback=true; fallback_attempts=2`. Restarting controller (rolling).
Alex W: controller restarted. Observing gradual drop in queue length from 11.4k -> 8.1k in 3m.
Priya S: good sign. keep an eye on error budget and tail latency. If queue not under 2k in 10m, escalate to platform-lead.
Ops Liaison: reserved node provisioning estimate ~6m; if that finishes we should be back to normal.
Jamie (support): updated ticket TKT-4492 with current status + link to PD incident.
Alex W: queue at 3.2k, 5xx back to baseline. I'll mark mitigation in the runbook and start handoff notes.
Priya S: please create a brief post-incident note with timeline + root cause: autoscaler fallback not enabled during spot quota exhaustion.
Alex W: will do. handing off to Priya for follow-up and RCA. tagging @oncall-next for awareness. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident INC12345 transitioned to "mitigated" at 1835000180.
_meta: generated by dataset-generator: slack thread reflecting pagerduty page, ack, manual scaling, autoscaler fallback bug, customer impact and handoff
